About the Field R&D Hubs

The FarmsKing Agronomy Research Hub was established as a practical agricultural research field laboratory to directly study ground-level farming challenges, crop physiology, plant health, and natural organic farming solutions.

Rather than relying purely on theoretical assumptions, all algorithms, spray calendars, and crop advisory routines on the FarmsKing Platform (farmsking.in) are practically validated in real crop fields across Punjab and partner states.
